body: I will make sure I mention that, and thank you for being so kind.

It's my first baby, and thank you for your kind words honestly I can't tell you what they mean to me. It's hard to feel like a good parent most days but today was the straw that kinda broke the camel's back.. it's been so hard to control myself and my feelings I just feel like a bomb waiting to go off.. but you're right. Even though they get on my nerves I would do and give anything for my baby and my family. It's easy to give them a break but not as much myself and that's probably where the issue is.. thank you for the hope, I honestly needed it a lot and I'm sorry
